heading.en: How Christ is both the Father and the Son—He will make intercession and bear the transgressions of His people—They and all the holy prophets are His seed—He brings to pass the Resurrection—Little children have eternal life. About 148 B.C.
heading.sm: O le ala ua avea ai Keriso o le Tamā ma le Alo—O le a faia e ia le 'ai'oiga ma tauave solitulafono a Ona tagata—O i latou ma perofeta paia uma lava o Ana fanau ia—Ua faataunuu e ia le Toetutu—E maua e fanau laiti le ola e faavavau. E tusa o le 148 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now Abinadi said unto them: I would that ye should understand that God himself shall come down among the children of men, and shall redeem his people.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa fai atu Apinati ia te i latou: Ou te manao ia outou malamalama o le a afio mai le Atua lava ia i totonu o le fanauga a tagata, ma o le a togiola e ia ona tagata.

verses.en: And because he dwelleth in flesh he shall be called the Son of God, and having subjected the flesh to the will of the Father, being the Father and the Son—
verses.sm: Ma ona e soifua o ia i le tino o le a ta’ua o ia o le Alo o le Atua, ma ona ua tuu atu e ia le tino i le finagalo o le Tamā, ona o ia o le Tamā ma le Alo—

verses.en: The Father, because he was conceived by the power of God; and the Son, because of the flesh; thus becoming the Father and Son—
verses.sm: O le Tamā, ona sa fanauina o ia i le mana o le Atua; ma o le Alo, ona o le tino; ua faapea ona avea ai o ia o le Tamā ma le Alo—

verses.en: And they are one God, yea, the very Eternal Father of heaven and of earth.
verses.sm: Ma o i la’ua o se Atua e tasi, ioe, o le Tamā Faavavau lava lea o le lagi ma le lalolagi.

verses.en: And thus the flesh becoming subject to the Spirit, or the Son to the Father, being one God, suffereth temptation, and yieldeth not to the temptation, but suffereth himself to be mocked, and scourged, and cast out, and disowned by his people.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona avea le tino e pulea e le Agaga, po o le Alo i le Tamā, o se Atua e tasi, e mafatia i tofotofoga, ae lē gaua’i atu i le tofotofoga, ae tuu atu o ia lava e tauemuina, ma sasa, ma tuli i fafo, ma faatō e ona tagata.

verses.en: And after all this, after working many mighty miracles among the children of men, he shall be led, yea, even as Isaiah said, as a sheep before the shearer is dumb, so he opened not his mouth.
verses.sm: Ma a mavae nei mea uma, a uma ona faia e ia vavega tetele i totonu o le fanauga a tagata, o le a ta’ita’i atu o ia, ioe, e pei lava ona fai mai Isaia, e pei o se mamoe gūgū i luma o le selefulufulu, ua faapea ona lē tatalaina e ia lona fofoga.

verses.en: Yea, even so he shall be led, crucified, and slain, the flesh becoming subject even unto death, the will of the Son being swallowed up in the will of the Father.
verses.sm: Ioe, o le a faapea lava ona ta’ita’i atu o ia, faasatauroina, ma fasia, ma avea ai foi le oti ma pule i le tino, ua o gatasi le loto o le Alo ma le finagalo o le Tamā.

verses.en: And thus God breaketh the bands of death, having gained the victory over death; giving the Son power to make intercession for the children of men—
verses.sm: Ma e faapea ona motusia e le Atua noataga o le oti, ina ua manumalo o ia i le oti; ma tuu atu ai i le Alo le mana e fai ai le ’ai’oiga mo le fanauga a tagata—

verses.en: Having ascended into heaven, having the bowels of mercy; being filled with compassion towards the children of men; standing betwixt them and justice; having broken the bands of death, taken upon himself their iniquity and their transgressions, having redeemed them, and satisfied the demands of justice.
verses.sm: Ina ua afio a’e i le lagi, ua ia liuliualo i le alofa mutimutivale; ua faatumuina i le agaalofa i le fanauga a tagata; ua tu i lo latou va ma le faamasinotonu; ona ua motusia e ia fusi o le oti, ma ua ave e ia i ona luga a latou amioletonu ma a latou soligatulafono, ina ua ia togiolaina i latou, ma faamalie manaoga o le faamasinotonu.

verses.en: And now I say unto you, who shall declare his generation? Behold, I say unto you, that when his soul has been made an offering for sin he shall see his seed. And now what say ye? And who shall be his seed?
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te fai atu ia te outou, o ai na te tala atu lana tupulaga? Faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, pe a faia lona agaga o se taulaga mo agasala, o le a silasila o ia i ana fanau. Ma o lenei pe ni a fa a outou? Ma o ai o le a fai ma ana fanau?

verses.en: Behold I say unto you, that whosoever has heard the words of the prophets, yea, all the holy prophets who have prophesied concerning the coming of the Lord—I say unto you, that all those who have hearkened unto their words, and believed that the Lord would redeem his people, and have looked forward to that day for a remission of their sins, I say unto you, that these are his seed, or they are heirs of the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Faauta ou te fai atu ia te outou, soo se tasi na faalogo i upu a perofeta, ioe, o perofeta paia uma o e sa vavalo e uiga i le afio mai o le Alii— Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o i latou uma o e na faalogo i a latou upu, ma ua talitonu o le a togiolaina e le Alii ona tagata, ma sa tulimata’i i lena aso mo se faamagaloga o a latou agasala, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o i latou ia o ana fanau, po o i latou ia o suli o le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: For these are they whose sins he has borne; these are they for whom he has died, to redeem them from their transgressions. And now, are they not his seed?
verses.sm: Ona o i latou ia na tauave e ia a latou agasala; e mo i latou ia na maliu ai o ia, e togiola i latou mai ia latou soligatulafono. Ma o lenei, pe lē o i latou ea ia o ana fanau?

verses.en: Yea, and are not the prophets, every one that has opened his mouth to prophesy, that has not fallen into transgression, I mean all the holy prophets ever since the world began? I say unto you that they are his seed.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma pe lē o perofeta ea, i latou taitoatasi ia sa tatala lona fofoga e vavalo atu, o e e le’i pa’u’ū atu i le solitulafono, o le uiga o perofeta uma lava ia na soifua talu mai le amataga o le lalolagi? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o i latou ia o ana fanau.

verses.en: And these are they who have published peace, who have brought good tidings of good, who have published salvation; and said unto Zion: Thy God reigneth!
verses.sm: Ma o i latou ia o e na latou tala’i atu le filemu, o e na latou aumai tala e lelei o mea lelei, o e na latou tala’i atu le faaolataga; ma fai atu ia Siona: Ua nofotupu lou Atua!

verses.en: And O how beautiful upon the mountains were their feet!
verses.sm: Ma ua matagofie na’uā o latou vae i luga o mauga!

verses.en: And again, how beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of those that are still publishing peace!
verses.sm: Ma lea foi, ua matagofie na’uā i luga o mauga vae o i latou o loo latou tala’i atu pea le filemu!

verses.en: And again, how beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of those who shall hereafter publish peace, yea, from this time henceforth and forever!
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e matagofie na’uā i luga o mauga vae o i latou o e o le a latou talai atu le filemu i le lumanai, ioe, mai i le taimi nei e oo i le faavavau!

verses.en: And behold, I say unto you, this is not all. For O how beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that is the founder of peace, yea, even the Lord, who has redeemed his people; yea, him who has granted salvation unto his people;
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua lē ona pau lea. Ona ua matagofie na’uā i luga o mauga vae o ia o lē na te aumai tala e lelei, o lē o le faavae o le filemu, ioe, o le Alii lava lea, o lē ua togiolaina e ia ona tagata; ioe, o ia o lē ua tuuina mai e ia le faaolataga i ona tagata;

verses.en: For were it not for the redemption which he hath made for his people, which was prepared from the foundation of the world, I say unto you, were it not for this, all mankind must have perished.
verses.sm: Ona a na leai le togiola ua faia e ia mo ona tagata, lea na saunia mai le faavaega o le lalolagi, ou te fai atu ia te outou, a na leai lenei togiola, po ua fano tagata uma.

verses.en: But behold, the bands of death shall be broken, and the Son reigneth, and hath power over the dead; therefore, he bringeth to pass the resurrection of the dead.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o le a motusia noataga o le oti, ma nofotupu le Alo, ma ua ia te ia le pule i luga o e ua oti; o lea, ua aumai ai e ia le toetutu mai o e ua oti.

verses.en: And there cometh a resurrection, even a first resurrection; yea, even a resurrection of those that have been, and who are, and who shall be, even until the resurrection of Christ—for so shall he be called.
verses.sm: Ma e i ai se toetu e oo mai, o se ulua’i toetu lea; ioe, o se toetutu lea o i latou o e na i ai, ma e o loo i ai, ma e o le a i ai, seia oo mai lava i le toetu mai o Keriso— ona o le a faapea ona ta’ua ai o ia.

verses.en: And now, the resurrection of all the prophets, and all those that have believed in their words, or all those that have kept the commandments of God, shall come forth in the first resurrection; therefore, they are the first resurrection.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o le toetutu mai o perofeta uma, ma i latou uma o e na talitonu i a latou upu, po o i latou uma o e sa tausi i poloaiga a le Atua, o le a oo mai i le ulua’i toetutu; o lea, o i latou ia o le ulua’i toetutu.

verses.en: They are raised to dwell with God who has redeemed them; thus they have eternal life through Christ, who has broken the bands of death.
verses.sm: E faatutu mai i latou e mau faatasi ma le Atua o lē na togiolaina i latou; o lea ua latou maua ai le ola e faavavau e ala ia Keriso, o lē na ia motusia noataga o le oti.

verses.en: And these are those who have part in the first resurrection; and these are they that have died before Christ came, in their ignorance, not having salvation declared unto them. And thus the Lord bringeth about the restoration of these; and they have a part in the first resurrection, or have eternal life, being redeemed by the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou ia o e ua i ai se vaega i le ulua’i toetu; ma o i latou ia o e na maliliu ae lei afio mai Keriso, i lo latou lē malamalama, ona sa lei folafola atu ia te i latou le faaolataga. Ma e faapea ona faataunuu e le Alii le toefuataiga o i latou ia; ma ua i ai sa latou vaega i le ulua’i toetu, pe ua maua le ola e faavavau, ona ua togiolaina e le Alii.

verses.en: And little children also have eternal life.
verses.sm: Ma ua maua foi e fanau laiti le ola e faavavau.

verses.en: But behold, and fear, and tremble before God, for ye ought to tremble; for the Lord redeemeth none such that rebel against him and die in their sins; yea, even all those that have perished in their sins ever since the world began, that have wilfully rebelled against God, that have known the commandments of God, and would not keep them; these are they that have no part in the first resurrection.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, ma matata’u, ma gatete i luma o le Atua, ona ua tatau ona outou gatete; ona e lē togiolaina e le Alii soo se tasi faapea o e e fouvale ia te ia ma oti i a latou agasala; ioe, i latou uma ia o e na fano i a latou agasala talu mai le amataga o le lalolagi, o e na fouvale ma le loto i ai e faasaga i le Atua, o e sa latou iloa poloaiga a le Atua, ae sa latou lē tausiaina; o i latou ia e leai sa latou vaega i le ulua’i toetu.

verses.en: Therefore ought ye not to tremble? For salvation cometh to none such; for the Lord hath redeemed none such; yea, neither can the Lord redeem such; for he cannot deny himself; for he cannot deny justice when it has its claim.
verses.sm: O lea pe ua lē tatau ai ea ona outou gatete? Ona e lē oo mai le olataga i ni tagata faapea; ona e lei togiolaina e le Alii se tagata faapea; ioe, pe mafai foi e le Alii ona togiola ni tagata faapea; ona e lē mafai e ia ona teena o ia lava; ona e le mafai ona teena e ia le faamasinotonu, a ua i ai ana aiā.

verses.en: And now I say unto you that the time shall come that the salvation of the Lord shall be declared to every nation, kindred, tongue, and people.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te fai atu ia te outou e oo mai le taimi o le a folafola atu ai le faaolataga a le Alii i atunuu uma, ituaiga, gagana, ma nuu.

verses.en: Yea, Lord, thy watchmen shall lift up their voice; with the voice together shall they sing; for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.
verses.sm: Ioe, le Alii e, o le a sii a’e e au leoleo o latou leo; ma o le a latou pepese faatasi i le leo e tasi; ona o le a latou faafesagai, pe a toe aumai Siona e le Alii.

w.en: they shall see eye to eye,

verses.en: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem; for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Alalaga ia i le olioli, pepese faatasi, outou nofoaga tuufua o Ierusalema; ona ua faamafanafanaina e le Alii ona tagata, ua togiola e ia Ierusalema.

verses.en: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.sm: Ua afe e le Alii lona aao paia i mata o atunuu uma; ma o le a vaai tuluiga uma o le lalolagi i le faaolataga a lo tatou Atua.
